prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one isolated realistic game object for an illustrated alpine orchard at blue-violet dusk: an old handmade wooden directional signpost. Transparent background. Grey-brown aged oak with warm honey highlights, visible lengthwise wood grain, small knots, fine cracks, chipped softened edges, rusty small nail heads away from center, a little lichen at post foot. Blank flat face with no writing or symbols, clear central area for text overlay. Board is broad enough for two lines of lettering. Subtle thickness and warm upper-left rim light, realistic natural painterly material matching a twilight farm, not cartoon. No grass, rocks, ground, scenery, people, cast shadow or additional objects. True alpha transparency outside the wooden silhouette, 5% transparent margin.
